text: Theo’s fascination with the stars was not merely a childhood pastime but a profound connection to his late mother, an astrophysicist who had instilled in him a deep sense of wonder about the cosmos. Her influence shaped his worldview, leading him to seek solace and inspiration in the night sky. This emotional bond drove his actions, as he often found himself looking up, searching for answers and comfort in the celestial bodies that his mother had once studied. Meanwhile, the fluffy things in the sky, which rain comes from, served as a gentle reminder of the ever-changing nature of life and the universe, mirroring the transient yet beautiful moments shared with his mother.
